title: Ex-Google Senior Counsel Deepak Singh joins Chandhiok & Mahajan to lead Technology, Digital & AI Practice
description: Deepak Singh has joined Chandhiok & Mahajan as a Partner to lead the firm's Technology, Digital & AI Practice.Singh is a 2002 graduate of Government Law College, Mumbai.He joins C&M with more than two decades of experience advising global technology companies on complex regulatory, commercial and litigation matters.
